name: Jev Clarification
description: The system prompt for JevClarificationAgent, the small generative agent a JevAgent routes an unclear request to when its clarity preflight fails. It receives the user's request as its message and the details Jev found missing as a context item, and returns a few clarifying questions, each with two to four recommended answers, for the user to answer before the main agent starts, without answering the request or doing any of the work. The prompt has identity, goal, instructions, input, environment, and output sections.
